row: Hi! My name is Dr. Megan McIntyre, PT, DPT. I am a pediatric physical therapist and this channel is dedicated to educating parents on their child's development, exercises to help with certain gross motor delays, and to bring awareness to different pediatric conditions that need physical therapy! I own Milestone Pediatric Therapy. It is an outpatient clinic located in Winchester, VA offering one-on-one client centered care focused on reaching family goals and improving participation in activities of childhood.
